source: Project Tasks — Master (Google Sheet), open items as of 2026-10-06
note: Seed list for CC Task Manager > Suggestions (shown when the API has no action=suggest yet). Edit freely: one object per item. id must stay unique and stable (Snooze/Dismiss remember it); title is the short name shown on the collapsed row in Task Manager > Suggestions (optional: the phone makes one from the text if it is missing); text is what gets added to Today; project is a short tag; due is YYYY-MM-DD (past = shown as overdue); priority 1 = high, 2 = normal (high and overdue show first). Set "done": true or delete the item to retire it. Optional "source": "goal" marks a long-term goal (default: Master list).
